analysis.title: Scientific Shorthand (Mathematical Symbols)
analysis.description: A slide explaining mathematical shorthand used by ecologists, featuring paper cutout illustrations of symbols (=, <, <<, >>, >, >, ~) on the left and a three-question fill-in-the-blank exercise on the right.
analysis.layout: The title and introductory text appear at the top. Below, the slide is split into two halves: on the left is a cluster of scrap paper cutouts showing various comparison symbols; on the right is an activity titled 'Symbol Match' with instructions and three numbered fill-in-the-blank items with tick box icons.

components.visibleText: Ecologists use specific symbols to quickly communicate relationships in their field notes.
Symbol Match: Fill in the blank with the correct symbol (<<, >>, or ~).
1. Plant growth in full sun [ ] Plant [ ] growth in pitch black.
2. Number of daisies in Quadrat 1 (14) [ ] Number of daisies in Quadrat 2 (15).
3. Oxygen levels in a polluted stream [ ] Oxygen levels in a clean stream.
